title: Apocalyptic Cinema
description: A woman in a peach satin dress sits alone in a decaying, ruined movie theater, holding a film reel on her lap. The ceiling is torn open to a purple and yellow apocalyptic sky with two nuclear mushroom clouds visible on the movie screen, while film strips, broken seats, and scattered reels litter the scene.
prompt: A lone woman in a faded peach satin dress sits in a destroyed vintage movie theater, holding a film reel on her lap, surrounded by scattered broken film reels, old movie posters on decaying yellow walls, and torn red velvet seats. The ceiling is ripped open revealing a dramatic sunset sky, while the movie screen shows two atomic mushroom clouds exploding over a desert, with film strips floating through the air, in a haunting surreal style.
